d: The 2026 US midterm elections could reshape Donald Trump's presidency and determine who controls Congress. With the economy, cost of living, immigration and political polarisation shaping the debate, will voters hand Democrats an opportunity to check Trump's power? From the battle for the House and Senate to crucial swing states, voter turnout and the growing influence of independent voters, the stakes extend far beyond Washington. Greg Beitchman speaks with Sreenath Sreenivasan, Co-Founder of the South Asian Journalists Association, and journalist Mary C. Curtis.
